text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I'm at a loss for words...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I had intended to prove how wonderful you 
are, Trainer... and yet...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
However, I promise you I will win next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It ended up like this this time, but... do 
you still believe in me?
choice_data_list: You have to believe in me too.
I need you to believe in me too

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It ended up like this this time, but... do 
you still believe in me?
choice_data_list: You have to believe in me too.
I need you to believe in me too

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes! I'll do my best to live up to 
your trust."

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Please look forward to my next race.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm aiming for first place so I can spoil 
you with all my might, Trainer~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Yes, I believe you. I never 
doubted you for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I promise I will live 
up to your feelings.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll be counting on your guidance.
